paragraph_unit: maximal contiguous run of one exact citation; noncontiguous repeated citation labels are disambiguated by occurrence without merging or correcting chapter numbers
reference_intervention: NATIVE versus exact word.replace('v','u') on the same normalized reference sentences; no other change
candidate_pool_source: native reference frequencies only, identical pool in both conditions
family_term: OFF in both conditions; families.json is empty
unused_rule_policy: nominal L/S/W rules absent from both control partitions are unidentifiable and excluded from key accuracy
normalization: exact hash-bound GDT832 casefold/ligature/NFKD alphabetic-word normalization; preserve every ordered representable word; exclude a whole control citation run if any word remains unrepresentable
gold_policy: original normalized control spelling is unchanged; never collapse u/v in gold, ciphertext or recovery metrics
blinding: procedural seed-defined keys; decoder operator does not inspect sealed plaintext or maps before fit lock
